quarantine.reason: origin/main carries the pre-fix upstream pair: backend/utils/conversations/projection_payload.py imports models.client_processing at module scope, while backend/tests/unit/test_batch_upload_storage.py and test_merge_validation.py stub `models` without that submodule, so every run fails with ModuleNotFoundError. upstream/main already fixed both sides (the stub list includes models.client_processing and the import moved into the function). backend/** is a T2 never-modify path, so the remedy is the next upstream sync, not a fork edit.

Every 'Typecheck - Lint - Test' run has failed since the unified-delivery branch landed. Run 34567708664 reports 44 errors and 846 warnings; all 44 errors are in fork-owned files under desktop/windows/fork/, and none is in an upstream file, so this is the fork's own debt rather than a T2 conflict. Removing the unused node:fs import in desktop/windows/fork/source-stage.mjs took the count from 45 to 44 and revealed the rest. The fix is mechanical (return types, any removal, empty method bodies) but needs the real desktop toolchain to re-run the staged tests, so it lands as its own change and this check is promoted back to required then.
